title: Experience clarifies amid missing details

captions.physics: Comparing accounts with an incomplete picture

meaning: Shared action amid incomplete information through understood experience is emotionally answered by clarity that does not equal final knowledge.
text: The Moon in the physical position of this Energy Field appears through shared actions amid incomplete information: you compare impressions and try accounts without a clear picture. The Hermit in energy motivates drawing on understood experience and sharing what has become clear. In emotions, the same Hermit brings a feeling of the past becoming understood. Repetition means no doubled certainty: earlier understanding can support a search while emotional clarity remains open to clarification. You can understand part of a story better without a final account or authority to explain another person’s experience.

For example, you examine old records of a journey you took together. Dates differ, and experience of earlier clarification suggests comparing notes rather than immediately choosing one. Gradually, the source of confusion becomes clearer. **We use understood experience and feel clarification while leaving room for the unknown.** Emotional satisfaction proves no accuracy in every reconstructed event and requires neither identical assessment of every memory nor an immediate end to further searching. Understanding can be useful while still incomplete.

Clarity becomes constricting if an explanation is declared the last word. New details then obstruct a calm picture, while different memories seem to be the other person’s mistake. The Hermit’s two roles supply no knowledge for both people and require no solitude. The Moon in action preserves an incomplete picture. Shared practice can allow different conclusions and more precise words without devaluing understanding already gained or someone’s right not yet to accept a finished account. A clear feeling remains revisable.
